А «вышележащие» зоны «березитов-2», так как сформировались преимущественно в оперяющих зонах рассланцевания и дробления, в рудный этап активизировались слабо (см. рис. 12).

В магнитном поле отложения вачской свиты за пределами ореола контактового метаморфизма имеют прямую намагниченность, она проявлена в положительных значениях порядка 100-250 гамм.

The eU map of the Wamba area exhibits a strikingly different spatial pattern from the K map, with high concentrations distributed across both the northern and southern sectors rather than confined to a single domain.

High eU values (≥3.8 ppm, orange-red-magenta tones) characterise much of the northern sector between 8°44'-8°58'N, consistent with the uranium enrichment typically associated with evolved granitic rocks and felsic gneisses of the kind inferred from the K map in the same domain.

This decoupling of uranium from potassium in the southern sector is geochemically significant: uranium readily leaches from its primary host minerals under oxidising conditions and is subsequently re-precipitated along structural discontinuities and redox boundaries, a process well-documented by Cuney and Kyser (2021) as the fundamental mechanism governing secondary uranium concentration in Precambrian basement terrains.

The elevated eU in the south therefore most plausibly reflects structurally controlled uranium mobility along the fault and fracture network inferred from the TDR and FVD maps, rather than primary lithological enrichment.

Две из этих аномалий в целом совпадают с протяженными Главной и Северной антиклинальными зонами.
